description: This Java source file defines the InstanceModeHelper class, which provides utility methods for changing instance mode configurations in the Fineract integration tests. It includes deprecated methods for modifying read/write/batch worker modes and relies on external libraries such as Gson and RestAssured.

classes.name: InstanceModeHelper
classes.description: Utility class for changing instance mode settings within integration tests, including deprecated methods for mode modification.

methods.name: changeMode
methods.description: Deprecated method to modify the instance's read/write/batch worker/batch manager modes via a PUT request to the server.
